# HELP llamacpp:prompt_tokens Total number of prompt tokens processed.
# TYPE llamacpp:prompt_tokens counter
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{model="demo",n_ctx="4096"} 4096
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{model="demo"} 512
# HELP llamacpp:tokens_predicted Total number of tokens generated.
# TYPE llamacpp:tokens_predicted counter
llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total{model="demo"} 2048
# HELP llamacpp:requests_processing Number of requests currently processing.
# TYPE llamacpp:requests_processing gauge
llamacpp:requests_processing 4
# HELP llamacpp:requests_deferred Number of requests deferred (queued).
# TYPE llamacpp:requests_deferred gauge
llamacpp:requests_deferred 2
# HELP llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode Average number of busy slots per decode.
# TYPE llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode gauge
llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode 1.5
# HELP llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds Histogram of prompt processing.
# TYPE llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds histogram
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds_bucket{model="demo",le="0.1"} 0
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds_bucket{model="demo",le="1"} 3
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds_bucket{model="demo",le="+Inf"} 4
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds_sum{model="demo"} 1.85
llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds_count{model="demo"} 4
# HELP llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds Histogram of inter-token latency.
# TYPE llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds histogram
llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds_sum{model="demo"} 12.0
llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds_count{model="demo"} 2000
